shots.name: Forehand Drive
shots.summary: A compact, low-to-high drive with contact out front. Watch the clip, then mimic the swing path.
whatToWatch: Shoulder turn loads first — the hips and shoulders coil before the arm moves.
Contact point is out in front of the lead hip, not beside the body.
Low-to-high swing path: the paddle starts below the ball and finishes high across the body.
Weight transfers forward onto the front foot through contact.

shots.name: Backhand Drive
shots.summary: A stable two-hand backhand drive. Study the idealized reference skeleton and mimic the shape.
whatToWatch: Unit turn: shoulders rotate together so the paddle sets behind the back hip.
Stay low through the shot — knees bent, level head.
Contact slightly in front of the body with a firm wrist.
Follow through toward the target, finishing high.
